name: QUAN DUI 全對
description: Qu?n Du? is a Chinese Rummy-like draw-and-discard game from Dongguan, Guangdong. Players collect a 16-card hand of eight pairs, with identical pairs able to claim priority from the discard.

content.text: Qu?n Du? is a Chinese Rummy-like draw-and-discard game from Dongguan, Guangdong. Players collect a 16-card hand of eight pairs, with identical pairs able to claim priority from the discard.

Country/Region of Origin: China (Dongguan, Guangdong province). The game uses Dongguan Pai (Chinese money cards). Rules were recorded from observations of games between Chinese players in Amsterdam. Cultural Significance: Social card game in Chinese communities.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional
Money-suited 39 card family used in Chinese money-card games.

Standard 52-card deck
